_readme: To add a new product: copy one object inside 'items' below, give it a unique 'slug' (must be unique across the whole file) and set its 'category' to one of the product category slugs used in assets/data/products.json (e.g. 'mens', 't-shirts'). Add the matching image file under /assets/images/products/<category>/ and re-run scripts/build_site.py. The category's catalog page (/products/<category>/) and this item's own detail page will both update automatically.
